projects.name: Germany | Domain: Insurance
details: • Designed and maintained automated regression test suites in Tricentis Tosca across web and Windows application layers,
improving test coverage by 40%.
• Built and managed Tosca Reusable Test Blocks (RTBs), recovery scenarios, and complex test structures to increase script
maintainability and reuse.
• Executed Tosca Distributed Execution (DEX) via test event creation and registration, enabling parallel test runs across
environments and reducing manual testing effort by 50%.
• Managed Tosca Test Data Services (TDS) to support dynamic, data-driven testing.
• Led test planning, requirement analysis, script design, execution, and defect lifecycle management using JIRA.
• Coordinated defect triage and resolution with cross-functional development teams to meet release timelines.

projects.name: Life and Pension Annuity, UK | Domain: Insurance
details: • Performed manual testing across insurance sub-modules using functional, regression, system, integration, and user acceptance
testing approaches.
• Owned requirement analysis, test scenario/case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect reporting.
• Used Master Craft DevPlus and JIRA for test management and defect tracking.
• Partnered with development and cross-team testers to resolve blockers through knowledge-sharing and coordination.
• Produced traceability matrices, test outcome reports, and daily/weekly defect reports.
• Collaborated with product owners on backlog management and continuous delivery of features.

projects.name: Life Insurance
details: • Flagged and resolved system/report errors, escalating IT tickets to prevent recurrence.
• Managed BaNCS application user access, including authorizations, team realignment, and account transfers.
• Analyzed functional specifications and provided resolution guidance to the customer service team.
• Authored configuration and workflow documentation reflecting ongoing process changes.
• Represented the team in pre/post-release IT forums, flagging release impact on existing processes.
• Created business permission documentation and clarified user access requirements.
SHIVTEJ RAMCHANDRA GURAV

projects.name: Overdraft | Domain: Banking
details: • Managed business and retail overdraft accounts for Bank of Montreal (US & Canada), coordinating with portfolio managers via
email and calls.
• Processed cross-border fund transfers between Canadian and US accounts using daily foreign exchange rates.
• Delivered monthly presentations on productivity, quality, volumes, and escalations.
• Trained new associates and cross-team trainees on process procedures.
• Participated in financial transaction audits to maintain quality standards.
